rows.reply: I couldn't move it — the level display's row is already packed (unit label on its right, inside the Process panel), and a 200x76 lamp won't fit right of it anywhere on this screen; the body has no free card cells either. Tell me which object to shift or drop, or I can add a second screen for the pump detail.

Nothing on this screen is bound to any tag. All seven tags in the project (PMP_101_RUN, PMP_101_FLT, PMP_102_RUN, PMP_102_FLT, FT_101_PV, LT_101_PV, LT_101_HI) are declared but unused. The six objects that should show live data — the four lamps (o7 Lamp_PUMP1_RUN, o8 Lamp_PUMP1_FLT, o9 Lamp_PUMP2_RUN, o10 Lamp_PUMP2_FLT) and the two numeric displays (o14 Num_Flow, o17 Num_Level) — are all unbound. The validator flags each of them as a warning. Say the word and I'll bind them.

Added a momentary START PUMP 2 switch in the footer of PumpStation1, bound to a new PMP_102_START BOOL — the tag list only had run feedback and fault, so the command tag had to be created; point it at the real starter address if the PLC names it differently. The body, header and nav are full, so the button sits in the footer rather than next to the Pump 2 lamps.

OTE only rounds Rectangles, so I put a rounded plate behind the title text — the header was full, so it went in as a child of the banner. Note: the match/align follow-up ops were refused because the new object's handle wasn't resolvable in the same pass, so the plate may need nudging to sit exactly behind the title text; say the word and I'll reposition it.
